In summary, our research is concerned with
the computation of analytic expressions of the Next-to-Leeding-Order (NLo) QCD corrections for the process pp -> Higgs + 2 jet + X, where Higgs is a scalar particle of mass 100-150 GeV.
the calculation of analytic formulae for Higgs + 2 jet production at the Next-to-Lead- ing-Order.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the analytic NLO QCD corrections to the Higgs plus two jets process have been computed and the results are now available in the form of compact and efficient computer programs.
, in the limit of large top quark masses and small jet transverse momenta, analytic expressions for the NLO QCD corrections to the process Higgs+2 jets have been obtained.
the analytic results for the NLO QCD corrections to the Higgs + 2 jet production at hadronic colliders have been obtained and are available for use by the experimental collaborations.
